adaptationNote: The unchanged shared course_test.hpp from Book II B02-L0110 is placed first; the local include is removed. CHECK stays active in optimized builds.

guide.problem: Insert or remove nodes without losing the rest of a chain.
guide.design: Links make local rewiring possible. A vector is simpler and often faster for traversal-heavy work.
guide.invariant: Every owned node is released once; next/previous links agree where both exist.
guide.failure: Overwriting next before saving its old value loses the remainder. A shallow owning copy may double-delete nodes.
guide.trace: Save the successor, reconnect the neighbor, then release the removed node.
guide.maintenance: Test empty, singleton, middle removal, copy/move, and destruction paths.
guide.scope: This panel connects this listing to its chapter’s problem. Short demonstrations illustrate one part; the chapter’s complete implementation and invariant labs test the broader contract.

experiment: Predict one boundary or tie case, then change this listing and trace the affected state. Save the successor, reconnect the neighbor, then release the removed node.

checks.label: Original behavior
checks.hint: Compare the first changed output, assertion, or process exit. Preserve the stated invariant before changing the expected result.
